description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A small rectangular caddy has two empty cylindrical wells and a centered loop handle. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
